limits: Positive result is limited to the supplied symbolic grammar and measured task distribution.
Policy-training cost has not amortized in this campaign.
The composed family was already known from v1; v2 uses fresh instances, not an unseen-family claim.
Retention, automatic routing, active curiosity and abstraction invention remain future work.
Neither Repair Graph nor adaptive Llama is a general natural-language assistant.
Recorded adaptive chat still predicts 0,2; instead of 2,2; on the documented first-world prompt.
Resource observations are tiny shared-host runs, not reliable latency benchmarks.
